title: Sim Works Taquito Pedals in Stock in Silver and Bronze
content:
Sim Works‘ Taquito debuted in August at the Made Bike Show in Portland, in a limited Sunrise colorway. Now the Portland-based branch of Sim Works USA  just received stock from Sim Works Japan in Silver and Bronze…

For a while now, riders have asked Sim Works for a more compact Taco pedal, and Sim Works could have just scaled the Taco down, but it worked with MKS on a new forged pedal body and kept the Taco’s side plates. The platform is 5 mm shorter on each side, 10 mm in total. That’s a good fit for smaller shoe sizes and for touring bikes with low bottom brackets, where every millimeter of clearance matters.

The Taquito Pedals are made by the pedal final bosses at MKS. If you’d like to read the development story on these pedals, roll on over to Sim Works to see all the neat features packed into a tasty-sounding pedal! And check out inventory at Sim Works.
